claims.claim: The target is an active men’s clothing collection with tracksuits, hoodies, sweatshirts, joggers, T-shirts and shorts.
The target grid currently lists MENS BOLT TRACKSUIT, MENS SONIC TRACKSUIT and MENS NORTHMAN TRACKSUIT, alongside hoodie, short and jogger options.
MENS DT CNS RACING HOODIE lists full sleeves, a drawcord hood, pocket, 300 GSM construction and 65% polyester/35% cotton fabric.
MENS BOLT TRACKSUIT lists a zipper neck, full sleeves, cut-and-sew pattern, Wicktech technology and 90% polyester/10% spandex fabric.
The ten internal destinations were live and canonical during the rendered check.
Fit, category and styling guidance is editorial assistance organised around customer need.
